title: MondoBoricua/MT3K-Mac-Tools
summary: Native macOS setup utility — curated app catalog installer (Homebrew, npm, DMG, GitHub releases), Brave debloat, local dictation, Battery Guard, and live menu bar stats. Swift 6 + SwiftUI.

title: vikramgorla/whatsapp-agent-duniya
summary: Self-hosted AI agents for your WhatsApp groups and chats, managed from a calm web panel. Any model, MCP tools, free to host on Oracle Cloud or Google Cloud.

title: mikybuilds/lanterna
summary: A friendly AI assistant on free cloud models or your own local models (Ollama). Windows app + Linux terminal app. 7 languages.

title: MouseWurX/Bob
summary: Bob: a local AI agent with a personality. Tools, 256K+ context, code, research, pictures and voice, plus an AI Lab to cut and test models and his own llama.cpp engine that switches experts live, can turn them on or off to test cuts before you make them, can intelligently divide experts, merge models, and more! On your PC, Mac, Linux, or phone.

title: EthanYoQ/Pagekin

Imitate, continue, rewrite; import writing skills. Local-first, no model bundled. Windows & macOS.

title: quditmind/pathos
summary: Open-source Application Security Posture Management: scanning, findings lifecycle, SBOM, AI-assisted review (cloud or local models) and MCP - Docker-first

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
summary: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain language, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local.

title: veeresh-bikkaneti/antigravity-local
summary: Local Antigravity: run the Google Antigravity SDK against a model on your own computer, served by Ollama. No cloud account, no API key. One command to set up, or one Docker image.

title: utkualsir/sharkyclips
summary: Free, local AI clipper for streamers: finds the best moments in your Twitch / YouTube / Kick VODs, bleeps swears, writes titles and posts 9:16 clips to YouTube, TikTok and Reels. Runs 100% on your PC.

title: Pinvou/pinvou-agent
summary: Open-source desktop AI agent for tools, files, knowledge, workflows, and real deliverables.

title: alitinart/pilot
summary: Host your own coding assistant instantly

title: genex-games/genex-desktop
summary: Desktop app for game dev with AI: make games in Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot or the browser. The agent sets up the engine, builds your game and play-tests it by itself.

title: aisixteen/fantastic
summary: A medium that unifies humans and AIs into a single workspace: a kernel where models, programs, files, shells and a live canvas are all agents, reached by one call.

title: furkanbati/enterprise-rag-assistant
summary: RAG assistant with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, source citations and an evaluation harness. Runs locally (Ollama) or with OpenAI.

title: Leo00703/pi-local-server
summary: Auto-discover local LLM servers (llama.cpp, LM Studio, Strata, Ollama, vLLM…) on your machine, LAN and Tailscale, with their real context window. Extension for Pi, plugin for OpenCode.

title: everybodyai/quickai
summary: Run AI models on your own computer: local AI that you control. A small desktop app for chat, code, vision, voice, images and video, with llama.cpp, Ollama and ComfyUI. Windows and Linux; macOS coming soon.

title: 4meinn/cthulhu-llm-redteam
summary: Prompt injection and jailbreak testing for LLM apps you own. An attack corpus runs against a local target with a planted canary, two scorers check each reply, a guardrail is measured before and after, and results map to the OWASP LLM Top 10.

title: m4bwav/labwright
summary: Local AI servers (ComfyUI, Ollama) as one read-only pool for coding agents

title: Cerlancism/subsvibe
summary: Live subtitles with vibes - AI powered real-time context-aware subtitles backed by MAI Transcribe/Scribe/Whisper/Qwen ASR and LLM refinement, through local or OpenAI compatible endpoints

title: IncarnaMind/IncarnaMind
summary: From messy files to a checked report. A free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux: write and analyse with AI from your own files, check each sentence and figure against them, and export to Word. Meeting notes too. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or a local model through Ollama.
